component.name: ScholarPath Beta
component.summary: Scholarship, University & Internship Finder for International Students

description.p: ScholarPath helps international students discover scholarships, universities, internships and part-time jobs, check eligibility, plan budgets, prepare visas, and track applications — with an official Minecraft-inspired dark theme.
Beta: works exactly like the website at https://rafie-kun-scolarship-app.vercel.app — includes Settings tab for your Gemini API key.
First beta desktop release — Windows .exe + Linux AppImage/.deb + Flatpak
